description: For roofing repair, this completion sign-off form records leak history, wet-area boundary, repair method, temporary protection, materials, weather window, and occupant coordination. Its supporting evidence includes moisture readings, test cuts, infrared or visual findings, photos, water test, and repair detail.

blocks.guidance: Link this roofing repair record to its evidence.

blocks.guidance: Stop for unsafe access, lightning, saturated deck, suspected hazardous materials, or structural deterioration. Route unresolved roofing repair work for review.

subtitle: Roofing Repair Completion Sign-Off Form: roof leak diagnosis and repair execution using roof area, leak history, and moisture readings.
title: Roofing Repair Completion Sign-Off Form
use_case: Use the completion sign-off form during roof leak diagnosis and repair execution when the roofing repair record must identify roof area, membrane or shingle system, penetrations, drainage, interior symptom, access, and warranty status. Complete the applicable handoff for watertightness verification, repair photos, warranty disposition, maintenance note, and customer signoff.
